projects.name: M6 Motorway Stage 1
projects.description: Twin 4km tunnels linking M8 Motorway at Arncliffe to President Avenue at Kogarah. Will include new shared cycle/pedestrian pathways, pedestrian bridge across President Ave, and upgrade of Princes Hwy/President Ave intersection. First publicly-owned motorway via NSW Motorways. Toll proposed at $2.44 each way. Construction halted March 2024 due to sinkholes, now resumed. Originally expected 2024, delayed to late 2028.

key_details.issues: Sinkholes halted construction March 2024, possible reverse fault geological issues
key_details.future_stages: Section B (Kogarah-Taren Point), Section C (Taren Point-Loftus), Section D (Loftus-Waterfall) — all shelved indefinitely

projects.name: Sydney Metro City & Southwest — Sydenham to Bankstown
projects.description: Conversion of Bankstown line from Sydenham to Bankstown for autonomous metro trains. Phase 1 (Chatswood-Sydenham) opened 19 Aug 2024 with 7 new underground CBD stations. Phase 2 converts 11 existing stations. 12-month closure from Sept 2024 for conversion. Delayed by industrial action to 2026. Part of 66km metro line. Total project cost blew out to $20.5B (originally $11.5-12.5B).

key_details.line_name: M1 Metro North West & Bankstown Line
key_details.impact_note: Sydenham-Bankstown closure Sept 2024 for 12 months conversion. Improved frequency and reliability will boost suburbs on T8 line (Wolli Creek, Arncliffe, Banksia, Turrella) due to reduced congestion and better interchange at Sydenham.

projects.name: Sydney Metro West — Westmead Station
projects.description: New metro station at Westmead on Sydney Metro West line. Interchange with existing T1/T5 rail and Parramatta Light Rail.

projects.name: Sydney Metro West — Parramatta Station
projects.description: New metro station at Parramatta on Sydney Metro West line. Major over-station development planned. Interchange with T1/T5 rail and Parramatta Light Rail.

projects.name: Sydney Metro West — Sydney Olympic Park Station
projects.description: New metro station at Sydney Olympic Park. Over-station development approved 2024. Major new town centre planned with significant commercial and residential development.

projects.name: Sydney Metro West — North Strathfield Station
projects.description: New metro station at North Strathfield. Interchange with existing T9 Northern Line.

projects.name: Sydney Metro West — Burwood North Station
projects.description: New metro station in Burwood North. First rail connection for this area. Station Package West contract awarded to Gamuda ($2.85B) in Jan 2025.

projects.name: Sydney Metro West — Five Dock Station
projects.description: New metro station at Five Dock. First rail connection for Five Dock — a suburb that has never had a train station.

projects.name: Sydney Metro West — The Bays Station
projects.description: New metro station at The Bays precinct (former White Bay power station area). Major urban renewal precinct.

projects.name: Sydney Metro West — Pyrmont Station
projects.description: New metro station at Pyrmont near The Star casino. Over-station development EIS under assessment. Office and retail development planned above station.

projects.name: Sydney Metro West — Hunter Street Station
projects.description: CBD terminus of Metro West. Hunter Street station contract awarded to Metropolis Consortium (Lendlease, Mirvac, Coombes Property Group) at $1.5B in Jan 2025. Over-station commercial towers approved (East and West) in 2024. Interchange with Wynyard and Martin Place via pedestrian connections.

projects.name: Sydney Metro Western Sydney Airport — St Marys Station
projects.description: St Marys metro station — interchange with T1 Western Line. Northern terminus of Metro WSA line.

projects.name: Sydney Metro Western Sydney Airport — Orchard Hills Station
projects.description: New metro station at Orchard Hills. Stabling and maintenance facility also located here. Operations Control Centre.

projects.name: Sydney Metro Western Sydney Airport — Luddenham Station
projects.description: New metro station at Luddenham. Part of Western Sydney Aerotropolis growth area.

projects.name: Sydney Metro Western Sydney Airport — Airport Business Park Station
projects.description: New metro station at the Airport Business Park precinct of Western Sydney International Airport.

projects.name: Sydney Metro Western Sydney Airport — Airport Terminal Station
projects.description: Metro station directly serving Western Sydney International Airport terminal. Interchange with airport.

projects.name: Sydney Metro Western Sydney Airport — Bradfield Station
projects.description: Southern terminus of Metro WSA line. Located in the new Bradfield City Centre (Aerotropolis). Major new city development planned.

projects.name: WestConnex Motorway Network
projects.description: 33km motorway network - Australia's longest road tunnel (22km). M4 widening (2017), M4 East (2019), M8 (2020), M4-M8 Link (Jan 2023), Rozelle Interchange (Nov 2023). All stages now complete. M8 connects at Arncliffe to future M6. Stub tunnels at Arncliffe enable M6 connection. Total cost ~$20B+. Operated by Transurban (51% stake).

key_details.m8_arncliffe_interchange: M8 has interchange at Arncliffe — direct motorway access from target suburbs
key_details.m6_stub_tunnels: Stub tunnels built into M8 at Arncliffe for future M6 connection
key_details.impact_note: WestConnex already lifted inner-west property values. Arncliffe M8 interchange provides direct motorway access improving connectivity to CBD and airport

projects.name: Parramatta Light Rail Stage 1 (L4 Westmead & Carlingford Line)
projects.description: 12km light rail line from Westmead to Carlingford via Parramatta. Opened 20 December 2024. 16 stations operational. Operated by Great River City Light Rail (Transdev/CAF joint venture). 13 Urbos 100 trams.

projects.name: Parramatta Light Rail Stage 2a (Camellia to Wentworth Point)
projects.description: 4.5km extension from Camellia to Wentworth Point. 9 new stations. Construction commenced late 2024, major works began 2025.

projects.name: Parramatta Light Rail Stage 2b (Wentworth Point to Sydney Olympic Park)
projects.description: 5.5km planned extension from Wentworth Point to Sydney Olympic Park via Carter Street. 5 planned stations. Will connect with Metro West at Sydney Olympic Park.

projects.name: Western Sydney International Airport
projects.description: New international airport at Badgerys Creek. Expected to open 2026. Will create major employment hub and drive growth across Western Sydney. Metro WSA line will serve airport from April 2027.

projects.name: St George Hospital Stage 3 Redevelopment
projects.description: $277M redevelopment completed. 9-level Acute Services Building constructed above operational ED — first of its scale in NSW. Includes 52-bed ICU/HDU, cardiac cath unit, 128 inpatient beds, sterilising services, 8 additional digital operating theatres. Built by Multiplex. Hospital is UNSW teaching hospital, serving ~250,000 residents of southern Sydney.

key_details.designation: Tertiary referral hospital, major teaching hospital (UNSW)

projects.name: St George Hospital — Future Expansion Planning
projects.description: Ongoing planning for further capacity expansion at St George Hospital to meet growing population demands in southern Sydney. South Eastern Sydney LHD has identified need for additional capacity as Bayside/St George area population grows. Major health employment anchor for Kogarah/Hurstville area.

projects.name: Arncliffe Central Mixed-Use Development
projects.description: Major mixed-use development near Arncliffe station along Princes Highway corridor. Will transform the area with significant residential and commercial components. High-density development that will increase amenity but also add unit supply. Watch unit oversupply risk vs improved amenity and foot traffic for existing house owners.

key_details.location: Princes Highway corridor near Arncliffe station
key_details.risk_note: High-density development may create unit oversupply in immediate area. Houses on surrounding streets likely benefit from improved amenity without supply pressure.

projects.name: NSW Transport Oriented Development (TOD) Program
projects.description: NSW Government program to speed up delivery of new homes near metro and rail stations. Higher density rezoning within 400-800m of transport hubs. Arncliffe, Banksia, Rockdale and Wolli Creek stations are all candidates for TOD rezoning under this program. Could see R2 zones around stations rezoned to R3/R4. Massive impact on land values within walking distance of stations.

key_details.impact: R2 → R3/R4 rezoning around stations dramatically increases land value due to higher development potential
key_details.status: Active policy — councils being given housing targets
key_details.arncliffe_note: Arncliffe station area likely candidate for higher density rezoning

projects.name: NSW Low & Mid-Rise Housing Policy (Housing SEPP)
projects.description: State-wide housing reform expanding permissibility for dual occupancies and medium-density housing in R2 zones. Overrides local council LEPs where more permissive. State-wide minimum 450sqm with 12m frontage for dual occ. Now in effect. Directly enables duplex development in Arncliffe, Banksia, Bexley, Rockdale and other target suburbs even where local council was previously more restrictive.

key_details.impact: Expands development potential across all R2 zones in target suburbs

projects.name: Bayside Council Housing Strategy & LEP Amendments
projects.description: Bayside Council housing strategy under development. Likely to increase density around stations (Arncliffe, Banksia, Rockdale, Wolli Creek). Council received housing targets from NSW Government. LEP amendments expected to allow higher density in station precincts. Bayside LEP 2021 is the current planning instrument.

key_details.housing_targets: NSW Government has set 5-year housing completion targets for Bayside Council

projects.name: Sydney Gateway Motorway
projects.description: New motorway connection linking WestConnex (St Peters Interchange) to Sydney Airport and Port Botany. Improves access from southern/western Sydney to airport. Benefits Arncliffe/Wolli Creek area residents with better airport and freight corridor access.

projects.name: T8 Airport & South Line — Capacity Improvements
projects.description: With Metro City & Southwest conversion of Bankstown line (Sydenham-Bankstown), T8 Airport & South Line services through Wolli Creek, Arncliffe, Banksia, Turrella will benefit from reduced congestion at Sydenham junction. The removal of Bankstown line trains from Sydenham enables more frequent/reliable T8 services. Effectively improves rail service for all target suburbs on the Illawarra line.

projects.name: Princes Highway Corridor Upgrade — Bayside
projects.description: Planned upgrades to Princes Highway corridor through Arncliffe, Banksia, Rockdale as part of broader urban renewal and M6 integration. Includes intersection improvements at President Avenue/Princes Highway (part of M6 Stage 1 works).

projects.name: Cooks River Cycleway Improvements
projects.description: Ongoing improvements to Cooks River cycleway and shared paths through Arncliffe, Bardwell Park, Wolli Creek area. Part of broader Sydney cycling network. Enhances liveability and active transport options. M6 project includes new shared cycle/pedestrian pathways.

projects.name: M6 Stage 1 — New Cycling & Pedestrian Infrastructure
projects.description: As part of M6 Stage 1, new shared cycle and pedestrian pathways will be built, plus a new pedestrian bridge across President Avenue. Includes upgrades to Ador Park and McCarthy Reserve at Rockdale, and Brighton Memorial Playing Fields.

projects.name: Kogarah Town Centre Renewal
projects.description: Kogarah is identified as a strategic centre under the Greater Sydney Commission's District Plan. Town centre renewal expected with M6 completion improving access. St George Hospital anchor employment. Train station + future M6 motorway access make Kogarah a major beneficiary.

projects.name: Rockdale Town Centre Urban Renewal
projects.description: Rockdale identified for urban renewal. R3/R4 zoning near town centre. M6 construction activities currently impacting area (Rockdale Bicentennial Park), but completion will bring upgraded open spaces and improved amenity. New recreational facilities being built to offset construction impacts.

projects.name: Hurstville Town Centre — Strategic Centre Development
projects.description: Hurstville is a designated Strategic Centre in the South District Plan. Multiple high-density residential and commercial developments underway. Major retail centre (Westfield Hurstville). Significant Chinese-Australian community driving investment. Benefits from T4/T8 rail and bus interchange.

projects.name: New Sydney Fish Market
projects.description: New Sydney Fish Market at Blackwattle Bay. Major tourist and commercial attraction. Part of Blackwattle Bay urban renewal precinct. While not directly in target suburbs, signals broader infrastructure investment in Sydney and improves overall city amenity.

projects.name: Bayside Area School Capacity Upgrades
projects.description: NSW School Infrastructure is planning capacity upgrades across the Bayside area to accommodate population growth. This includes expansions to existing schools and potential new school sites. Growing student population driven by high-density development. Key schools: Arncliffe Public School, Bexley North Public School, Rockdale Public School, Kogarah Public School.

projects.name: UNSW — St George Hospital Clinical Campus
projects.description: UNSW has an established clinical teaching campus at St George Hospital, Kogarah. Creates ongoing demand for rental accommodation from medical students, residents and hospital staff. Anchor institution supporting rental demand in Kogarah/Hurstville/Rockdale area.

arncliffe.combined_impact: VERY HIGH — M6 motorway (direct access), WestConnex M8 interchange already built, Arncliffe Central development, TOD rezoning candidate, metro upgrade improving T8 services. Potential 15-25% uplift over 5 years from infrastructure alone.

banksia.combined_impact: HIGH — Benefits from M6, improved T8 services, TOD rezoning potential. Quieter and more affordable than Arncliffe. Good duplex potential.
risks: Smaller suburb with limited amenity currently

rockdale.combined_impact: HIGH — M6 cycling/pedestrian upgrades, town centre renewal, TOD rezoning. Good existing amenity base. R3/R4 zoning near centre already.
risks: M6 construction impacts on open space (Bicentennial Park)

kogarah.combined_impact: HIGH — M6 southern terminus (President Ave), St George Hospital anchor, UNSW campus, strategic centre status. Strong institutional base.

wolli_creek.combined_impact: MODERATE-HIGH — Already highly developed (apartment dominated). Benefits from metro upgrade and improved T8. Limited house stock.
risks: Predominantly apartments — limited house investment opportunity

hurstville.combined_impact: HIGH — Major strategic centre with significant development activity. Strong retail and commercial base. Different LGA (Georges River) but benefits from broader area uplift.

bexley.combined_impact: MODERATE — Benefits from M6 via improved access. Predominantly R2 residential with good duplex potential. Heritage character areas.
risks: Heritage conservation areas may limit development in some streets

turrella.combined_impact: MODERATE-HIGH — Small, quiet suburb with station. Metro upgrade improves T8 service. Very affordable entry point relative to neighbours. Good value play.
